report.status_line: Caution: Water trailer tank broken, ATV fuel empty, and static water transfer failed on final mission sol.

concerns.title: ATV Fuel Depleted Without Resupply
concerns.detail: The crew reported that all ATVs are empty of fuel, no fuel resupply was received, and moisture is building up in the fuel tanks.

concerns.title: Water Trailer Tank Broken and Static Transfer Failure
concerns.detail: The commander reported that the water trailer tank is broken. Engineering also reported that water did not flow from the static tank when attempting to fill the loft tank in the morning. Since the 2015-01-17 refill 6 days ago, static tank level is dropping ~5 cm/day to 38 cm from top, leaving remaining water volume unknown.

concerns.title: Consumable and Cleaning Supply Shortage for Handover
concerns.detail: The commander reported a shortage of toilet paper with no resupply received, and no response regarding cleaning supplies required to clean and handover the Hab to incoming Crew 148.

crew_actions: Provide a final total water volume estimate before departure, as water remaining is unknown following the 2015-01-17 refill.
Troubleshoot the static tank transfer line and pump to determine why water failed to flow into the loft tank.
Secure ATV fuel tanks against moisture buildup while awaiting fuel resupply.
Inventory remaining toilet paper and cleaning supplies to prepare handover notes for Crew 148.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve water trailer tank repair and schedule static tank refills for incoming Crew 148.
decisions_for_earth.why: The trailer tank is broken and water remaining is unknown following the refill 6 days ago.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Authorize an ATV fuel resupply prior to incoming crew operations.
decisions_for_earth.why: ATVs are empty and accumulating fuel tank moisture, halting motorized surface mobility.

report.message_to_earth: Operations are at caution on mission end day due to a broken water trailer tank and depleted ATV fuel. The trailer tank broke, and water did not flow from the static tank during morning loft filling. Static tank level is 38 cm from the top, dropping ~5 cm/day since the 2015-01-17 refill, leaving water remaining unknown. The crew is inspecting the transfer line and securing ATV tanks against moisture. Diesel is at 50% and propane is at 30%, while toilet paper and cleaning supplies remain unreplenished. Approve water replenishment and trailer repair plans for Crew 148 before handover tomorrow. Next report tomorrow morning at handover.
